blocks.text: What a wonderful time! God has saved the best information for this very hour. Like the wise men, in this letter we’re going to go into the celestial signs for the return of Christ. The heavens are surely active right now. I didn’t have room in the last monthly letter to mention all the activity. The 2014-April 23rd date is listed as one of the greatest grand squares in the heavens. The numbers are 13, 13, 13, 13 (a square). Not until the end of 1,000 years do we see anything close to this. – Aug. 25, 2013 was also a grand square. – The Jan. 02 through 22nd, 2014 is also a grand square. These special signs are definitely speaking of the Lord’s very soon return. And now a very important Christmas letter from Brother Neal Frisby’s library.

“There are two events in history and each are of extreme importance, which overshadow all other events! One event has already been fulfilled. Jesus’ first coming! – The other is His second coming to catch away His saints! – Right now let’s talk about His first coming and then, will He appear soon in our generation?” – “There were 5 vital and important signs in the heavens which were associated to the birth of Christ. (1) A very significant comet appeared beforehand. The same comet comes once every 75 years since! It was heralding the birth of a King! (2) On the night Jesus was born (Luke 2:9) a glowing bright light lit up the countryside near Bethlehem. And the angel of the Lord spoke to the shepherds out of the sparkling light! – They were told to go to a stable, and there would be the promised Saviour! (3) The wise men. These wise men were called the Magi. They understood the signs of the times. They knew the heavens! (Gen. 1:14) – And they knew a ‘star out of Jacob’ was coming! – I always felt that they were from the East, Babylon or Persia area. So I looked in Webster’s dictionary and it says: ‘the priestly caste in ancient Persia, in the Bible the wise men who came bearing gifts to the infant Jesus!’ – They came to Him because they saw his star!” (Matt. 2:2) Also there was a light that went before them and stood right over the place where Jesus was! It may have been the bright amber cloud that led and went before Israel in the wilderness! Also wherein Elisha exclaimed, “the chariot of Israel and the horsemen thereof!” (II Kings 2:11-12) – “The Lord was the ‘lively light’ in the cloud that shone at night over Israel!”

(4) “According to history there was an amazing conjunction of the planets of Jupiter and Saturn. Not once, but 3 times in a period of 9 months! From the conception of Jesus by the Holy Spirit to His very birth! Even scientists today claim that it occurred at that time.” – “According to the ancient wise men who understood the heavens these type of conjunctions always herald the birth of Royalty! – And was He ever a Royal King!” – Isa. 9:6 says, “and His name (Jesus) shall be called Wonderful, Counsellor, The Mighty God, The Everlasting Father, The PRINCE of Peace!” (Heaven’s Royalty!) – (5) And also at the last conjunction not only did these two planets come together, but they were joined by the planet Venus; and it would give the appearance in similarity as the moon in its fullness! So in symbolism it matched the statement where Jesus said, “I am the Bright and Morning Star.” (Rev. 22:16) – “So all of these manifestations brought the Jews and Gentiles to worship Him as Saviour, Lord and King!” – “So we see God uses His heavenly creation to show forth His glory, His will and predestined purpose! Yes, the appointment was made with man as predicted. He came out of Eternity into our time zone to redeem us. Hallelujah!”

“Now the return of the Lord Jesus is getting very near. It is my opinion that He will appear soon in our generation! Events in our era will begin to happen swiftly.” – “Jesus confirms this, for He says, ‘Behold I come quickly’ several times before the closing of the book of Revelation. (Rev. 22:7, 12) – What a thrilling expectation we have, that in a moment, in a twinkling of an eye we shall be changed and caught up to meet the Lord in the air. And shall ever be with the Lord! (I Thess. 4:17) – What ecstasy, we shall see Jesus face to face. Our bodies will be changed into the likeness of His glorious body! Never again will the elect be subject to pain, sickness or death!” – “The righteous dead shall be resurrected and together we shall all join in the mighty triumphant meeting in the clouds with Jesus!” – “Also the Scriptures proclaim that as the heavens declared the first coming of Christ, they will herald His second coming in our generation! – For Jesus said, ‘There shall be signs in the stars, in the sun and in the moon.’ (Luke 21:25) – And that fearful sights and great signs shall there be from the heaven!” End quote.

This month I am releasing an important book called, “The Creative and Prophetic Universe” which will fit right in with all the celestial signs. Also a very wonderful DVD called “The Creator Visits Man.” There are some special CD’s this month that you definitely want to have in your library. – Be sure and help us at this time because our expenses have been great and next year we want to do more than ever in this harvest time message. We must do as much as we can while we can. Jesus will surely prosper and bless you. You can count on it!
